svg.title: Shinseina Ki — Sacred Heartwood. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Wood classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Hallowed Seed forks into Rooted in Wisdom then Heartwood Awakened. Grasping Roots forks into Rootbound Prey then Judgement of the Grove, or Fangs of Heartwood then The Forest Devours. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu.

60 AP, cooldown 7), two 35% self Increase Damage Given rows on the 40 AP Forest Wisdom cast, and one 35% Increase Damage Taken row on Grove's circle. Its biggest spike comes from those three multipliers compounding (\u00d71.35\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.46 on a window hit). Hallowed Seed answers \"How do I make Forest Wisdom's two rounds my strongest window?\" with sustained amplification of the caster's own Wood, Earth, Water and element-less hits (both rows on the kit's attacks). Grasping Roots answers \"How do I turn the Grove's catch into a kill: open it to every attacker, or set up a heavier Wood strike?\" with the exposure route and the burst route: Fangs of Heartwood's +1% Forest Wisdom setup, then a controlled +2 Damage payoff on The Forest Devours (the Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura shape; see above_nuke_rationale). Raw Damage sits apart from the full self buff, so no build stacks it on the +6% window. Recoil, poison, wound, summon and visual rows are unsupported, and Wood Warrior Summon (PVP only) carries no supported row. DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":25.0,"gain":0,"final":25.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["The Forest Devours"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts, as before the 2026-10-04 batch, rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Damage x3, Increase Damage Given x2 on one cast, Increase Damage Taken x1), so it holds exactly three identities: sustained amplification (Hallowed Seed \u2192 Rooted in Wisdom \u2192 Heartwood Awakened), exposure (Grasping Roots \u2192 Rootbound Prey \u2192 Judgement of the Grove) and burst (Grasping Roots \u2192 Fangs of Heartwood \u2192 The Forest Devours). A fourth capstone could only repeat one of those tags on the same rows. Universal node accepted: Grasping Roots is in all 8 legal full builds, because Heartwood Awakened's only prerequisite-closed fourth purchase is the other Foundation. A second Hidden Art under Hallowed Seed would be filler: an Increase Damage Given leaf twins Rooted in Wisdom on the same two rows and stacks with Heartwood Awakened, an Increase Damage Taken leaf twins Rootbound Prey, and a Damage leaf puts flat Damage on a Hidden Art (Eternal Forest 51 without a capstone) and becomes Heartwood Awakened's best fourth, raw Damage on the full +6% window.","design_notes":["Structure: edges 01\u219204\u219205, 06\u219207\u219208 and 06\u219202\u219203. Hallowed Seed +2% / Rooted in Wisdom +1% / Heartwood Awakened +3% Increase Damage Given (route +6%); Grasping Roots +2% / Rootbound Prey +3% / Judgement of the Grove +5% Increase Damage Taken (route +10%); Fangs of Heartwood +1% Increase Damage Given (setup) / The Forest Devours +2 Damage (payoff), on Grasping Roots' +2% exposure. Any two capstones cost 5 or 6 BP. 8 legal full builds (6 numerically non-dominated): five capstone builds and three without a capstone. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +6%, Increase Damage Taken +10%, Damage +2 (only with The Forest Devours).","History: the first pass of this batch removed flat Damage and shrank the tree to six nodes because any flat Damage lifts Eternal Forest past 50; the roster pass restored the burst route at +2 (the pre-batch route was +5, 40 \u2192 45 and 50 \u2192 55) but split it +1 on Fangs of Heartwood, so Eternal Forest reached 51 in three builds without the payoff. Final cleanup: The Forest Devours carries the whole +2 and Fangs of Heartwood is a +1% Increase Damage Given setup on Forest Wisdom, so only builds holding the capstone exceed 50 (the Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura shape, RUL-2026-10-04-001/002). The setup is not a twin of Rooted in Wisdom: the two sit under different Foundations, neither is a legal fourth for the other's route, and they meet only in the no-capstone 01, 02, 04, 06 (+4%, numerically dominated). Increase Damage Taken was not used for the setup: it would twin Rootbound Prey, its sibling under Grasping Roots, and put Judgement of the Grove + Fangs of Heartwood at +11%. Placement is forced by twin avoidance, not by the Foundation sentence: Fangs of Heartwood acts only on Forest Wisdom, Hallowed Seed's axis, and raises own Wood, Earth, Water and element-less hits whether or not the target is caught, so Grasping Roots' sentence covers it only loosely; under Hallowed Seed it would sit beside Rooted in Wisdom as a stacking twin (Heartwood Awakened + Fangs of Heartwood +7%; The Forest Devours + Rooted in Wisdom +4% under the +2 Damage).","Why the printed totals differ: every Increase Damage Given point lands on both Forest Wisdom rows, which compound, so the +6% route is \u00d7(1.41/1.35)\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.091 on own hits in the window; the +10% exposure route is \u00d71.45/1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.074 on every attacker's hits on the caught enemies; the +2 Damage payoff is \u00d71.05 (\u00d71.04 on Eternal Forest) on every Wood cast, in or out of a window. Duel opener (Forest Wisdom and Grove in round 1, Serpent and Eternal Forest in rounds 2 and 3) against the unmodified kit: The Forest Devours + Hallowed Seed \u00d71.099, Heartwood Awakened + Grasping Roots \u00d71.091, Judgement of the Grove + Hallowed Seed \u00d71.090. Burst leads the opener and every 40 EP Wood strike, in the window (\u00d72.74 against \u00d72.72 in the circle, \u00d72.00 against \u00d71.99 away from it) and outside it (\u00d71.05 against \u00d71.00); sustained amplification leads only on non-Wood own hits in the window (element-less, Earth, Water: \u00d71.99 against \u00d71.90 away from the circle) and on Eternal Forest by under 0.4% (\u00d72.72 against \u00d72.71 in the circle, \u00d71.99 against \u00d71.98 away from it); exposure leads on allies' hits (\u00d71.45).","No-capstone builds (01, 02, 04, 06 at +4% Increase Damage Given / +2% exposure, numerically dominated by Heartwood Awakened + Grasping Roots; 01, 02, 06, 07 and 01, 04, 06, 07, both +3% / +5%) carry no Damage and are weaker in every situation than the capstone build suited to it; they exist only because the structure allows them.","Fourth purchases: Heartwood Awakened takes Grasping Roots only. Judgement of the Grove takes Hallowed Seed (duel) or Fangs of Heartwood (+1% on both Forest Wisdom rows, numerically dominated by Hallowed Seed's +2%). The Forest Devours takes Hallowed Seed (Forest Wisdom 38%; the solo and duel default, see concerns) or Rootbound Prey (exposure 40%, team; duel opener \u00d71.092, still above Heartwood Awakened's \u00d71.091).","Interactions (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73/\u00a73b): Forest Wisdom row 0 (no element, Highest filter) matches the kit's Wood hits, every element-less hit of any stat and elemental hits of the caster's highest stat; row 1 (Earth/None/Water/Wood) matches those elements. Matching rows each multiply the hit, and Grove's exposure multiplies again; the bloodline passive (25+0.15/level, Wood/Earth/Water/None) multiplies last. Formula damage is linear in EP (tags.ts powerEffect 1436\u20131461), so +2 EP is \u00d742/40 on a 40 row before every multiplier.","Delivery and timing: cooldown 7 on every jutsu; buff and debuff rows act only in the two rounds after their cast. Forest Wisdom (40 AP, SELF) and Grove (60 AP, radius-1 circle on an OTHER_USER target, range 4) fit one round, so Serpent and Eternal Forest land in the shared window; Grove's exposure never amplifies its own hit, and in that opener only the burst route raises it."],"risks":["Classification: Wood is the single qualifying element; sharing it with Nature's Blessing is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). Forest Wisdom row 0 and Grove's exposure carry no element, so they need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver; the three Damage rows carry Wood natively. Wood Warrior Summon carries no Wood row and no supported row. Off-kit Wood coverage (NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN) is unverified.","Damage tier: every build with The Forest Devours lifts Eternal Forest 50 \u2192 52 EP, past the Nuke tier (above_nuke_rationale; director review); no allocation without it carries Damage. Serpent and Grove stop at 42, Normal tier. The +2 reaches every Wood Damage row, so an off-kit Wood row at 45 or 50 would read 47 or 52; the validator enumerates kit rows only.","Stacking: Heartwood Awakened's two Forest Wisdom rows compound with each other and with Grove's exposure (\u00d71.41\u00b2 \u00d7 1.37 \u2248 \u00d72.72 on a window hit in its complete build); Judgement of the Grove's 45% applies to every enemy in the circle and to every attacker's hits, so its team value grows with the number of allies. Not simulated.","Ally hazard: Grove's damage row (friendly fire absent = ALL) and poison row (ALL) hit allies standing in the radius-1 circle at cast time; The Forest Devours raises that damage to 42 EP. The exposure row is ENEMIES only.","Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"01":"How do I make Forest Wisdom's two rounds my strongest window?","06":"How do I turn the Grove's catch into a kill: open it to every attacker, or set up a heavier Wood strike?"},"route_identities":{"05":"sustained amplification: the caster's own Wood, Earth, Water and element-less hits in the Forest Wisdom window (both rows on the kit's attacks and element-less hits)","08":"exposure: every matching hit on the enemies caught in the Grove circle, from any attacker (team, area; \u00d71.074)","03":"burst: Fangs of Heartwood primes Forest Wisdom, then a controlled +2 Damage payoff on every Wood strike"},"director_review":"Roster questions: DQ-A (Eternal Forest 50 \u2192 52 only in builds holding The Forest Devours, the controlled +2 payoff after Fangs of Heartwood's Forest Wisdom setup; kit fact: the dossier's trait is Burst; see above_nuke_rationale); DQ-B (Judgement of the Grove +10% Increase Damage Taken on 1 row: Guardian's Grove 35 \u2192 45%; \u2248 \u00d71.074, against Shakunetsu Sakura \u00d71.075 and Blood-Enchanted Eyes \u00d71.115). Tree-specific: The Forest Devours + Hallowed Seed is the solo and duel default over sustained amplification (at or above Heartwood Awakened on every 40 EP kit strike; duel opener \u00d71.099 against \u00d71.091; third concern). Heartwood Awakened is 2/1/3 = +6%, below the two-row convention, because with Fangs of Heartwood's +1% under Grasping Roots the burst build already leads at +6% and any raise takes the window and the opener from it (first concern). Options: keep +6% (burst stays the Burst-trait kit's default); +7% (Rooted in Wisdom +2%: opener \u00d71.104, a narrow lead); 2/2/4 = +8%, the two-row convention (Rooted in Wisdom +2%, Heartwood Awakened +4%: \u00d71.122 on own window hits, opener \u00d71.117, the clear duel default); under either raise burst keeps the strikes outside the windows. Or keep Damage unamplified.","concerns":["Heartwood Awakened is 2/1/3 = +6% (\u00d71.091 on own window hits), below the two-row convention 2/2/4 = +8% (\u00d71.122) that R3 allows and most of the roster's other two-row Increase Damage Given routes use; R3 does not require the +1% Rooted in Wisdom. The actual reason is the burst route: with Fangs of Heartwood's +1% under Grasping Roots, the burst build already leads at +6% (third concern), and +6% is the largest route total that keeps it there. At +7% (Rooted in Wisdom +2%) sustained amplification takes the window and the duel opener back narrowly (\u00d72.76 against \u00d72.74 on a caught 40 EP hit; opener \u00d71.104 against \u00d71.099); at +8% (Rooted in Wisdom +2%, Heartwood Awakened +4%) clearly (\u00d72.80; opener \u00d71.117, also above exposure's \u00d71.090). Under either raise burst keeps the strikes outside the windows (\u00d71.05 against \u00d71.00). The choice is in director_review.","With kit attacks Judgement of the Grove ties Heartwood Awakened at best in solo play (\u00d72.72 against \u00d72.72 on a window hit in the circle; \u00d71.88 against \u00d71.99 on own hits away from it). Its edge is allies' hits (\u00d71.45 against \u00d71.37) and off-element own hits in the circle (\u00d71.99 against \u00d71.93). Grove's damage row (friendly fire absent = ALL) and poison row (ALL) hit any ally inside the radius-1 circle at cast time, so the melee allies the exposure route serves must not stand next to the target when Grove is cast. Values left for the director.","Burst is now the solo and duel default over sustained amplification. Fangs of Heartwood's setup is on the same two compounding Forest Wisdom rows as Hallowed Seed (the kit's only non-Damage, non-twin commit), so the obvious fourth puts +3% on both rows under the +2 Damage, and The Forest Devours + Hallowed Seed is at or above Heartwood Awakened + Grasping Roots on every 40 EP kit strike: \u00d72.74 against \u00d72.72 in the window on a caught enemy, \u00d72.00 against \u00d71.99 away from the circle, \u00d71.05 against \u00d71.00 outside the windows. It also leads the duel opener (\u00d71.099 against \u00d71.091 and \u00d71.090), and even the team fourth, Rootbound Prey, edges Heartwood Awakened's opener (\u00d71.092 against \u00d71.091). Heartwood Awakened keeps only non-Wood own hits in the window (element-less, Earth, Water: \u00d71.99 against \u00d71.90 away from the circle, \u00d72.72 against \u00d72.61 in it) and Eternal Forest by under 0.4% (\u00d72.72 against \u00d72.71 in the circle, \u00d71.99 against \u00d71.98 away from it); exposure keeps allies' hits. The margins are under 1% on kit strikes and the dossier's trait is Burst, so this proposal accepts burst as the default; the roster pass rejected this shape for exactly this reason, so it is a tree-specific director question.","Grasping Roots is a universal node (all 8 legal full builds); see narrow_kit_exception."]},"above_nuke_rationale":"Fable proposal on the director precedent of RUL-2026-10-04-001 (Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Reaper's Embrace 50 \u2192 52) and RUL-2026-10-04-002 (Shakunetsu Sakura, Sakura-ame 50 \u2192 52): The Forest Devours' +2 Damage is the controlled payoff of Fangs of Heartwood's setup, +1% Increase Damage Given on both Forest Wisdom rows (cast Forest Wisdom, then strike in its two-round window), and lifts Eternal Forest 50 \u2192 52, past the 50 Nuke tier. Kit fact: the dossier's only trait is Burst, and Eternal Forest is the kit's rank-A finisher and only 50 EP row (60 AP, cooldown 7). Only builds holding The Forest Devours carry Damage, so no allocation without the capstone exceeds 50 and none adds more than +2; Exploding Wood Serpent and Guardian's Grove go 40 \u2192 42 and stay Normal tier. Pending director review."}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Judgement of the Grove path + Hallowed Seed
The Forest Devours path + Hallowed Seed
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHINSEINA KI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Wisdom · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
